items.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021
items.q: it’s with Philly Joe Jones so you know that’s some thrilling stuff you know

ctx.x: Yeah. Especially on a big stereo you know. It was just amazing. And then there’s so many, like bop, you know like on the other side, “Dr. Jekyll” you know stuff that’s really

— like I think there’s three things that are blues on the record. And then there’s that Red Garland thing “Billy Boy” which is kind of doing Ahmad Jamal but it’s with Philly Joe Jones so you know that’s some thrilling stuff you know.
Yes indeed. Do you remember the first gig where you ever made money and how much was it?
